description: This file defines the BlockForm class in Drupal, responsible for rendering and processing the form for block instance configuration, including visibility conditions, theme settings, region placement, and machine name generation.

classes.name: BlockForm
classes.description: A form class for creating and editing block instances, managing configuration, visibility conditions, and related settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as entity type manager, condition manager, context repository, language manager, theme handler, plugin form factory, and block repository.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate BlockForm with services from the container.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the block configuration form, including plugin settings, visibility, theme, region, weight, and machine name.

methods.name: themeSwitch
methods.description: Handles AJAX theme switching to update region options.

methods.name: buildVisibilityInterface
methods.description: Constructs the visibility conditions UI with tabs and condition-specific forms.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions like Save and Remove.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form, including plugin configuration and visibility conditions.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, saving plugin configuration, context mapping, and visibility conditions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the block entity and redirects to the theme display page.

methods.name: submitVisibility
methods.description: Updates visibility conditions on the block entity based on form input.

methods.name: getUniqueMachineName
methods.description: Generates a unique machine name for the block based on plugin suggestion.

methods.name: getPluginForm
methods.description: Retrieves the plugin form instance for a block plugin, if it supports forms.
